InvalidInput.field: RFC6901 JSON pointer, rooted at /report, /context or /choice; indices decimal zero-based

validation_order: each /report/blockers/i: kind, subject, reason in ascending index
string_validation: No trim/normalization. Check Empty -> ContainsNul -> TooLongUtf8. Whitespace-only nonempty IDs/diagnostics remain literal data in this pure slice; HOST must apply authoritative identity rules. UTF-8 bytes, not scalar count. Digest syntax exact sha256:+64 lowercase hexadecimal; any mismatch InvalidDigest.
semantic_precedence: after ALL structural input validation, nonempty blockers -> Blocked before freshness or cross-document checks
no blockers: source digest mismatch -> StaleSource
then target ID or revision mismatch -> StaleTarget
then empty missing list -> AllowedComplete regardless of choice
blocker_duplicate_policy: Keep identical blockers, including exact duplicates. Sort stable by kind ordinal then subject UTF-8 bytes then reason UTF-8 bytes; every supplied valid reason remains represented. Missing dependency IDs alone sort/deduplicate by UTF-8 bytes. No locale sorting/casefold.
typed_boundary: Actual Rust report/context revisions are u64 and enum values are closed. InvalidRevision/InvalidChoice/InvalidBlockerKind are reserved future decoding oracle errors, NOT constructible L0 Rust values. No serde/decoder added to this slice. Do not count impossible enum/out-of-range construction as executable domain RED.
authority: Clarifies unapproved M06-R1-R4 proposal; not adopted product behavior. Full archive/schema/extract/Undo remains separate.
